scope: Three current Q4 assessments with actual supplied data inspected as possible alternatives for routes removed by the two proposals; no edits to these assessments.

findings.reason: No comparison with a Coulomb potential or limits of the box model for atoms is asked.
E1 and E2 at fixed L are calculated, but physical interpretation of the width dependence is not demanded.

Qualitative uncertainty and distinction from instrument error are asked; explicit explanation of why exactly specified position and momentum cannot be prepared is not developed in the given task/solution.
Measurement and state description appear, but model-dependent collapse and its distinction from classical uncertainty are not fully demanded.
No delayed-choice arrangement or retrocausal interpretation is supplied.
No coincidence data or beam-splitter outputs.
No positron annihilation, conservation calculation or PET.
No deterministic time evolution of a state contrasted with probabilistic outcomes.
Task4 touches measurement versus classical pictures, but does not explicitly discuss reality using preparation and probability together.
No entanglement, spatially separated correlations, local models or signalling distinction.

records.title: Radioaktivitaet, Zerfall und Strahlenschutz

findings.reason: Tasks1/2 use the half-life for activity and remaining nuclei:320 kBq after18h at6h half-life becomes40 kBq and1/8. This directly exercises the current decay-law goal. This is a content observation, not an approval of the whole clinical package.
Shielding/protection are mentioned, but the application is not explained by radiation type, interaction and detection principle.
No sequence of nuclides or checks of A and Z.
No absorbed/equivalent/effective dose distinction or computation of a suitable dose quantity.
Protection is discussed, but activity is not differentiated from an appropriate dose quantity using energy deposition, weighting and uncertainties.
No comparison of nuclear energy options.

records.additionalBoundary: The supplied18%/20% shielding criterion is only an authored task premise; this countercheck does not validate real clinical safety or release the package.

findings.reason: A numerical low-speed time-dilation application appears; thought experiments and discussion of experimental evidence are not asked.
Tasks3/4 target GPS corrections, but the supplied answer only calls gravity a different gravitational state and does not explain the direction of its clock-rate effect.
No Minkowski diagram, world line or simultaneity analysis.
No spacetime coordinate transformation between inertial frames.
No derivation or critical interpretation of historical relativistic mass.
GPS gravitational clock effect is invoked, but spacetime geometry and black-hole event horizons are not assessed.
One-way signal travel time is not round-trip Einstein synchronization of separated clocks.

conclusion: The three actual material packages do not substantively close the20 formal route losses. Other four unmodified Q4 assessments are generic placeholders. No old claimed coverage was bulk carried into a verified set.
